Marissa / Aditya — quick feasibility summary and recommended canary config: 

Summary: Yes — we can meet P95 <=200ms for ~128-token prompts with streaming enabled for the expected workload, but it requires dedicated capacity and tuned batching + KV caching. The key is avoiding large batching on streaming paths and ensuring low tail latency via per-request prioritization.

Recommended initial Dedicated config (canary):
- GPU: 4 x A800-equivalent GPUs (or 4 x A100 80GB) in a single shard with multi-GPU sharded serving.
- Serving topology: 2 inference replicas behind a smart router (allowing 1 replica for failover).
- Concurrency tuning: set per-model concurrent request cap ~350 and global router concurrency limit ~400 to preserve headroom.
- Batching: small dynamic batches for streaming requests (batch size 4-8, max wait 8ms); larger batches for non-streaming endpoints.
- KV/Prefix cache: enable prefix cache on hot keys; expect 20–40% token reduction on repeated intents.
- Fallback: route to quantized 7B variant with relaxed latency SLA; include circuit-breaker after X% error/latency.

Risks / notes:
- Tail latency sensitive to bursty traffic; recommend canary with synthetic burst tests + prod-like traffic generator.
- Monitoring: we'll enable tracing and token-level latency breakdowns in the Console.

Action items (owner):
- Vivek: prepare cluster runbook & sizing doc (link to draft: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1a2b3c4d5e6f7g8h/view) — due EOD Thu.
- Aditya: schedule canary test and coordinate with FintechCo — propose Wed next week.
